svg.title: MPU-SIQS and YAFU-SIQS — 1 and 48 threads
svg.desc: Median wall time against decimal digits for balanced semiprimes on AMD EPYC 9B45 (Turin, Zen5). Blue is MPU-SIQS; red is YAFU. Dotted curves indicate 1 thread; solid curves indicate 48 threads. No shaded spread bands. Serial curves end where measurements end. Approximate bit sizes appear along the top; thin guides mark 1 second, 1 minute and 1 hour.
svg.text: AMD EPYC 9B45 (Turin, Zen5) · balanced semiprimes · 50–110 decimal digits

svg.text: Each point is the median wall time for one decimal-digit size; no spread bands are shown.
Balanced-semiprime inputs per digit: 20 at 50–59; 10 at 60–70; 5 at 71–80; 3 at 81–110.
Serial coverage: MPU-SIQS 50–102; YAFU 50–102 digits. Curves stop at available data; no extrapolation.
MPU-SIQS 08fc958a; YAFU 8110dfbd. Each program uses the same source revision at both thread counts.
